Method of Attack: Using infected IoT devices as relay points for SQL injection (SQLi), cross-site scripting (XSS), and local file inclusion (LFI) attempts
Running a simple SOCKS5 proxy on infected devices
Sending emails as part of spam campaigns
Relaying exploitation attempts for SQLi, XSS, and LFI flaws
Impacted Systems: IoT devices running stripped-down Linux distros
Attack Vector: Infection of IoT devices with malware running SOCKS5 proxy
Use of infected devices as proxy networks to relay attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Between 10,000 and 35,000 requests per day relayed by ProxyM bots
Botnet size reaching up to 10,000 infected devices in May-June 2017
